data.title: Shenzhen Longsys Announces Passage of 2026 Extraordinary Meeting Resolutions
data.description:
Shenzhen Longsys Electronics Co., Ltd. Class H ( (HK:9976) ) has issued an update.

Shenzhen Longsys Electronics Co., Ltd., a PRC-incorporated joint stock company with limited liability, said resolutions proposed at its 2026 third extraordinary general meeting were duly passed at a meeting held on Nov. 23, 2026. The meeting was chaired by Cai Huabo, the board’s chairman and an executive director, with all directors attending in person or electronically.

Voting combined on-site and network methods. A total of 869 shareholders and proxies attended, holding 224,941,059 shares, or approximately 49.1817% of shares entitled to vote; the company’s treasury shares were not voted.

data.title: FireFly reports second regional copper-gold discovery at Green Bay
data.description:
An announcement from FireFly Metals ( (AU:FFM) ) is now available.

FireFly announced Nash as its second significant regional copper-gold discovery in a month at the Green Bay project, less than 10km from the Ming Mine. Airborne electromagnetics, mapping and sampling identified the area, while maiden drilling returned 26.7m at 2.3% copper from 9.0m downhole, including 9.6m at 4.6%, and another intersection of 21.3m at 1.2%.

Surface work produced multiple copper-bearing trenches and approximately 44 rock-chip samples above 1% copper, with individual samples up to 19.8%; nearby RDI also returned 11.2m at 1.2% copper from 15.9m. FireFly holds an exclusive option to acquire the adjacent 16.5km² Brass Buckle claims, while Green Bay’s current mineral resource estimate totals 60.2Mt at 2.4% CuEq in Measured and Indicated resources, plus 23.5Mt at 2.5% inferred.

data.title: Greenbriar Reports California Housing Measures and Stock Option Grant
data.description:
Greenbriar Capital ( (TSE:GRB) ) just unveiled an announcement.

California voters approved Proposition 37 and Proposition 1 in November 2026 to help fund affordable housing and homebuyer assistance.

Proposition 37 allows up to $25 billion in state revenue bonds through the California Housing Finance Agency for fixed-rate second mortgages covering up to 17% of newly constructed homes priced at roughly $1 million to $1.5 million. Eligibility is based on residency, income, buyer contribution and primary residence, and the program is not limited to first-time buyers.

Greenbriar also granted 200,000 incentive stock options to a consultant, exercisable at $0.55 per share for three years.

data.title: Apollo Hill Permitting Review and DFS Update
data.description:
An announcement from Saturn Metals Ltd. ( (AU:STN) ) is now available.

The EPA has advised that Apollo Hill’s environmental approval application will undergo four weeks of public review. The company said the review and subsequent assessment could add approximately three months to the development timeline, shifting the planned Final Investment Decision from late 2027 to early 2028.

Saturn continued validation and assurance work on the DFS, identifying opportunities for further project optimisation. It elected to fully evaluate those opportunities, with additional engineering delaying the targeted DFS release from next month to early 2027; the company said this is not expected to affect the revised development timeline.
